title: Dimensions
formulas: Dimensional formula of a quantity: $[Q] = M^a L^b T^c$ (add A, K, mol, cd when the quantity needs them).
Principle of homogeneity: every term of a valid physical equation must have identical dimensions.
Dimensions give the unit: $[\eta] = ML^{-1}T^{-1}$ ⟹ viscosity is measured in Pa s.
keyPoints: Homogeneity tests an equation's form but never fixes the dimensionless factors (½, 2π) — a dimensionally correct equation can still be wrong.
summary: Dimensions covers essential principles and applications.
examNotes: Focus on Dimensions problems - significant marks.
